events.title: Presidency of Tokugawa Iemochi
events.descr: Holds office as shogun from 14 August 1858 to 29 August 1866 (8 years).

events.title: Presidency of Tokugawa Yoshinobu
events.descr: Holds office as shogun from 10 January 1867 to 3 January 1868.
